summary: The first ODI match between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka will be held at R.Premadasa Stadium, Colombo. This marks Mehidy Hasan Miraz's debut as Bangladesh's full-time ODI captain, succeeding Najmul Hossain Shanto. Bangladesh's last ODI victory was in November 2024 against Afghanistan, and they have since lost six matches, including two in the 2025 Champions Trophy. The probable XI for Bangladesh includes players like Tanzid Hasan Tamim and Litton Das, while Sri Lanka's lineup features Avishka Fernando and Pathum Nissanka. The match follows Sri Lanka's Test series win against Bangladesh.
